# Gear variants of the latest snapshot (FRV-200, FRV-201): the variant of each auction and the gear map the snapshot
# keeps (r.last.gear of a deep scan in the game, last.gear of the Battle.net feed). Shared by
# tests/forevermarket/gearfeed_test.lua (FM.GearVariant on the item link the game shows for the auction,
# FM.SnapshotAdd and FM.FinalizeSnapshot) and tests/feed/test_feed.py (gear_variant on the API's item, aggregate):
# both sides must give byte for byte the same strings.
#
# An API item auction carries item.id and, when set, item.context, item.bonus_lists and item.modifiers: the same
# numbers as the item link's fields 12 (itemContext), 13 (numBonusIDs) with the bonus IDs, then numModifiers with the
# type:value pairs. The link item:15638::::::::44:1485::1:1:12733:1:28:6061 is context 1, bonus list [12733],
# modifiers [{28, 6061}], variant "1:1:12733:1:28:6061".
#
# case <name>                                  a snapshot of the auctions below it
# auction <item> <buyout> <band> [context=<n>] [bonus=<id>,<id>...] [mods=<type>:<value>,...] [commodity]
#                                              an auction: buyout = total copper (one unit), band = time left 0-3;
#                                              the API item's context, bonus_lists and modifiers (left out = the API
#                                              has none); commodity = from the commodities list (never gear)
# variant <expected>                           the variant of the auction above ("-" for ""); none for a commodity
# gear <item> <variant> <min> <n> <band>       one variant of the item's gear entry, in the entry's order ("-" for
#                                              ""): its cheapest buyout, its auctions and the band of the cheapest
# nogear <item>                                the item has no gear entry
# Every item with gear lines has exactly those variants; every other item of the case has no entry.

# The ticket's two auctions and one more of the first variant: the cheapest of each variant, its auctions and band;
# the bonus IDs keep the API's order, the variants are sorted ("1" before ":").
case ticket-examples
auction 15638 13399 2 context=1 bonus=12733 mods=28:6061
variant 1:1:12733:1:28:6061
auction 15638 20000 3 bonus=12733,12001
variant :2:12733:12001
auction 15638 15000 1 context=1 bonus=12733 mods=28:6061
variant 1:1:12733:1:28:6061
gear 15638 1:1:12733:1:28:6061 13399 2 2
gear 15638 :2:12733:12001 20000 1 3

# An auction without the three fields has the variant "": a key with only "" has no entry (its cheapest buyout is
# the minimum of its fingerprints already).
case plain-only
auction 7542 9000 1
variant -
auction 7542 8000 2
variant -
nogear 7542

# A plain listing next to a suffixed one: both in the entry, "" first.
case plain-and-suffix
auction 7543 9500 2
variant -
auction 7543 9000 2 bonus=12733
variant :1:12733
gear 7543 - 9500 1 2
gear 7543 :1:12733 9000 1 2

# Two auctions of one variant at one price: the longer time left; a cheaper one later takes its band.
case tie-and-cheaper
auction 9414 10000 1 bonus=12728
variant :1:12728
auction 9414 10000 3 bonus=12728
variant :1:12728
auction 9415 12000 3 bonus=12728
variant :1:12728
auction 9415 11000 0 bonus=12728
variant :1:12728
gear 9414 :1:12728 10000 2 3
gear 9415 :1:12728 11000 2 0

# A context and a modifier without bonus IDs: the empty count of bonus IDs stays as an empty field.
case modifier-without-bonus
auction 13128 25000 2 context=1 mods=28:5243
variant 1::1:28:5243
gear 13128 1::1:28:5243 25000 1 2

# Commodities never have an entry, also one whose API item carries a bonus list.
case commodities
auction 2589 500 2 commodity
auction 2590 700 2 commodity bonus=12733
nogear 2589
nogear 2590
